task.title: Correct local performance acceptance cache and target semantics
task.description:
The 2026-07-29 final evaluation measured cold CLI and warm HTTP mutations against fresh 500-by-20 fixtures whose SQLite task projection was never seeded. The first measured mutation therefore rebuilt all 500 task tips, so the resulting misses do not isolate the optimized hot exact-ID mutation path.

Update workbook-bench to seed the disposable projection outside each timed cold-process and warm-server mutation sample, while adding a separate measured projection-bootstrap scenario. Attach executable per-scenario targets for cold single mutations at or below 200 ms, warm API update at or below 100 ms, and every ten-operation burst strictly below 1,000 ms so acceptance reports produce truthful pass/miss outcomes instead of not-evaluated. Preserve process counting, fixture isolation, Git durability, and all existing raw evidence. Record the exact source commit and binary checksum in future reports.

Acceptance: both SHA-1 and SHA-256 500-by-20 runs use at least 20 local samples; a mutation test proves deleting the unmeasured seed step changes the measured path; generated JSON and Markdown classify all local targets without manual arithmetic; and projection bootstrap remains visible rather than hidden.
